properties.name: Field feedback is processed by skill, not by reading: every issue or gap it names gets /root-cause, every idea for improvement or a new feature gets /brainstorm
properties.statement:
When reflow2 receives feedback from a project that uses it — a field report, a friction log, an appended feedback file, a first-use write-up — the agent triaging it MUST run the root-cause skill on every issue, defect or gap the feedback identifies, and MUST run the brainstorm skill on every idea for improvement or new feature it proposes. Automatically, as the standing way feedback is read; not when reminded. Set by Anthony on 2026-09-05 after reminding the agent of it on three consecutive triages ("then I don't have to remind this every time").

WHY THE SKILLS AND NOT JUST 'READ CAREFULLY': the same day this rule was set, a triage that read the code and wrote down a cause without the skill's steps got two of four causes wrong — a 'missing setter' that was really the schema-default injector (the BL-198 class), and 'two missing pairs' that were three — and running the skipped steps overturned both (fact:defect-a-verifications-level-and-method-can-be-set-only-at-birth-so-a-wrong-default-is-on-the-record-forever, revised the same day). The skill's own text predicts this: a cause reached at speed feels like understanding.

WHAT EACH HALF PRODUCES, so compliance is visible rather than claimed: root-cause leaves a dated TemporalFact per issue carrying the candidates considered, the discriminating measurement taken, a CAUSES edge from the artifact holding the cause, and a stated bound on what was not established; brainstorm leaves one exploratory Decision per idea in the reporter's words with the counter-argument beside it, linked (or carrying a written no-relation note) via review_relations. A triage that leaves neither has not followed this rule, whatever it concluded.

COMPLEMENTS rule:feedback-sources-have-a-priority-order-and-anthony-set-it, which says which feedback is read first; this says how each piece is read once it is.

ENFORCEMENT IS ADVISORY, AND THAT WAS CHOSEN — Anthony, 2026-09-09, asked directly: a triage that skips these skills blocks nothing. Nothing is gate-blocking; the rule stands as guidance and the detector below only reports.

⚠️ THE PROPERTY AND THIS PARAGRAPH USED TO DISAGREE, and that disagreement is why the ruling was put to him rather than assumed. The node already carried `enforced: false` — the schema's word for "advisory, and somebody said so" — while this text claimed nobody had ruled. Under this schema `false` and ABSENT are deliberately different states: `false` is a decision, absence is silence, and `dec:does-enforced-default-to-gate-blocking` removed the default precisely so the two could not be confused. A node asserting one while its own prose claimed the other is that same confusion, one layer up. It now says what it means.

THE DETECTOR IS BUILT AND IT REPORTS ONLY (`untriaged_report`, 2026-09-09): an Artifact GOVERNED_BY a `methodology` DesignRule with no outgoing CAUSES edge — a parked field report that produced no root-cause finding. Severity is a note and it never blocks, matching the ruling above.

⭐ WHAT MADE IT BUILDABLE WAS MEASURING WHY IT WAS NOT. The compliance edge this rule names — CAUSES, from the report to the finding it caused — existed in the vocabulary the whole time and had been drawn ONCE across seventeen field reports (measured 2026-09-09; 7 of the 17 carry any DOCUMENTS back-edge at all, and none of the four this rule governs carried a CAUSES edge except `art:dev-storyflow-feedback-2026-09-07b`). So the third leg was not missing for want of a detector: the second leg never told anybody to draw the edge, and a rule whose compliance nothing records cannot be checked by anything. The triage of 2026-09-09 drew its own seven back-edges before the detector was written, which is what gave the detector a true negative to distinguish from its three true positives.
